name: third-screen-dipg-validation-v1
frozen: 2026-11-06, before any NCATS_DIPG model, baseline or Bliss-reference run. f0_combined and f2_combined are copied unchanged from configs/almanac_validation.json and mono_only unchanged from configs/neural_benchmark.json. Nothing is selected; validation fold (f+1)%5 only stops training. Hypotheses and tests: configs/third_screen_confirmation.json.

f2_combined.purpose: all architecture/optimization changes with interpolated monotherapy

mono_only.purpose: information ablation: monotherapy values only, no identities or doses, Bliss offset

selection.scope: single frozen candidate per regime; no choice is made

comparisons: training-pair monotherapy on top of identities and doses
network vs the fixed Bliss rule on the same training-pair monotherapy
identities and doses vs the fixed Bliss rule
network vs additive ridge on the same inputs
learned function of monotherapy values vs the fixed Bliss rule
identities and doses beyond a learned function of monotherapy values
secondary: pair-cell contrast R2 and interaction residual R2 beyond Bliss with drug-jackknife intervals
verdict_rule: as in the ONEIL benchmark: lower error only if the pair-bootstrap and drug-jackknife intervals, every fold and every seed pairing agree
